droid-monkey attacked this Android app with a real-world fault and it failed. Fix the root cause.

## What happened
Attack `network_loss` (network_loss): Drop the network, then trigger the screen's submit or slow action; the app must not crash or go silent.
Steps: [{"fill": true}, {"fault": "network_off"}, {"tap": "place_order"}, {"settle": 5.3}]
Result: crashed: java.io.IOException: Unable to reach orders.monkeymart.example: no network
Crash: java.io.IOException @ com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.OrderRepository.submit(OrderRepository.kt:27)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.OrderRepository.submit(OrderRepository.kt:27)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutViewModel$placeOrder$1.invokeSuspend(CheckoutViewModel.kt:32)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutViewModel.placeOrder(CheckoutViewModel.kt:31)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutScreenKt.CheckoutScreen$lambda$20$lambda$18$lambda$17(CheckoutScreen.kt:77)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutScreenKt$$ExternalSyntheticLambda9.invoke(D8$$SyntheticClass:0)

## Diagnosis
Root cause: OrderRepository.submit throws IOException when the active network has no INTERNET capability (OrderRepository.kt:27). CheckoutViewModel.placeOrder launches that call in viewModelScope with no try/catch (CheckoutViewModel.kt:31-34), so the exception escapes the coroutine and kills the app. Even if it were caught, `placing` is only reset on the success path (line 33), so the button would stay in the spinner state with no message. The design gap is that a recoverable network failure is treated as a programmer error, and the ViewModel has no failure state for the UI to show.
Fix approach: In CheckoutViewModel, wrap orders.submit in try/catch(IOException) inside the launched coroutine. Store the failure in an observable `error` state and always reset `placing` in a finally block. CheckoutScreen should render that error as a message with a retry path, and keep the form values, which already survive in the ViewModel. Optionally, inject the repository or submit function so the ViewModel can be tested without a Context.
Evidence: app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/data/OrderRepository.kt:27 - submit throws IOException when isOnline() is false; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/data/OrderRepository.kt:32-35 - isOnline checks activeNetwork INTERNET capability, so a network drop reaches the throw; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutViewModel.kt:31-34 - viewModelScope.launch calls orders.submit with no try/catch; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutViewModel.kt:30,33 - placing is set true before submit and reset only after success; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutScreen.kt:76-78 - the Place order button calls vm.placeOrder with no error handling and no failure state rendered; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutScreen.kt:38 - OrderRepository is created in the composable with remember, so it is not injected or testable

## Files to change
- app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutViewModel.kt
- app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutScreen.kt

## Regression test
Add src/test/.../ui/CheckoutViewModelTest.kt. Extract a small submit interface (or pass a lambda) so the test can supply a fake that throws IOException. Fill all fields, call placeOrder, and assert that the test does not throw, that placing is false afterwards, that orderId is null, and that error is non-null. Before the fix the exception escapes viewModelScope and fails the test; after the fix it passes.

## Rules
- Fix the root cause in the files above with the idiomatic Android approach. Keep the change small and focused.
- Add exactly one regression test file under app/src/test (JVM unit test, preferred) or app/src/androidTest
  (instrumented), using only test libraries the project already has (see app/build.gradle.kts). It must fail on
  the old code and pass on the fixed code.
- Do not change build files or add dependencies. Do not touch unrelated code. Do not commit.
- Before you finish, call the compile tool on your test ('unit' or 'instrumented') and fix every error it reports.
- When done, reply with one short paragraph: what you changed and the test class name.

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

package com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.rememberScrollState
import androidx.compose.foundation.text.KeyboardOptions
import androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll
import androidx.compose.material3.Button
import androidx.compose.material3.Card
import androidx.compose.material3.CircularProgressIndicator
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.testTag
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.KeyboardType
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.lifecycle.viewmodel.compose.viewModel
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.OrderRepository
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.ProductRepository
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.priceLabel

@Composable
fun CheckoutScreen(
    productId: Int,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    vm: CheckoutViewModel = viewModel(),
) {
    val product = ProductRepository.cached(productId)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val orders = remember { OrderRepository(context) }

    val placedId = vm.orderId
    if (placedId != null) {
        Column(modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp).testTag("order_confirmed"), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Text("Order placed 🎉", style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)
            Text("Order $placedId is on its way to ${vm.city}.", modifier = Modifier.testTag("order_id"))
        }
        return
    }

    Column(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
            .padding(16.dp)
            .testTag("checkout_screen"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
        if (product != null) {
            Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                Row(Modifier.padding(16.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
                    Text("${product.emoji} ${product.name}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                    Text(product.priceLabel(), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.testTag("checkout_total"))
                }
            }
        }

        Text("Delivery details", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
        CheckoutField("Full name", vm.name, { vm.name = it }, "field_name")
        CheckoutField("Email", vm.email, { vm.email = it }, "field_email", KeyboardType.Email)
        CheckoutField("Phone", vm.phone, { vm.phone = it }, "field_phone", KeyboardType.Phone)
        CheckoutField("Address", vm.address, { vm.address = it }, "field_address")
        CheckoutField("City", vm.city, { vm.city = it }, "field_city")
        CheckoutField("Pincode", vm.pincode, { vm.pincode = it }, "field_pincode", KeyboardType.Number)

        ScanCouponButton()

        Button(
            onClick = { vm.placeOrder(orders, productId) },
            enabled = vm.isComplete && !vm.placing,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("place_order"),
        ) {
            if (vm.placing) CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.testTag("placing_order")) else Text("Place order")
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CheckoutField(
    label: String,
    value: String,
    onChange: (String) -> Unit,
    tag: String,
    keyboard: KeyboardType = KeyboardType.Text,
) {
    OutlinedTextField(
        value = value,
        onValueChange = onChange,
        label = { Text(label) },
        singleLine = true,
        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = keyboard),
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag(tag),
    )
}

5	import android.net.NetworkCapabilities
6	import kotlinx.coroutines.delay

10	data class OrderRequest(
11	    val productId: Int,
12	    val name: String,
13	    val email: String,
14	    val phone: String,
15	    val address: String,
16	    val city: String,
17	    val pincode: String,

20	/** Talks to the (fake) orders backend. Needs a working network connection, like the real one. */
21	class OrderRepository(context: Context) {
22	
23	    private val connectivity = context.applicationContext.getSystemService(ConnectivityManager::class.java)
24	
25	    /** Places the order and returns its id. */
26	    suspend fun submit(order: OrderRequest): String {
27	        if (!isOnline()) throw IOException("Unable to reach orders.monkeymart.example: no network")
28	        delay(1_500)
29	        return "MM-%06d".format(Random.nextInt(1_000_000))
30	    }
31	
32	    private fun isOnline(): Boolean {
33	        val caps = connectivity.getNetworkCapabilities(connectivity.activeNetwork) ?: return false
34	        return caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET)
35	    }
36	}

package com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.rememberScrollState
import androidx.compose.foundation.text.KeyboardOptions
import androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll
import androidx.compose.material3.Button
import androidx.compose.material3.Card
import androidx.compose.material3.CircularProgressIndicator
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.testTag
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.KeyboardType
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.lifecycle.viewmodel.compose.viewModel
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.OrderRepository
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.ProductRepository
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.priceLabel

@Composable
fun CheckoutScreen(
    productId: Int,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    vm: CheckoutViewModel = viewModel(),
) {
    val product = ProductRepository.cached(productId)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val orders = remember { OrderRepository(context) }

    val placedId = vm.orderId
    if (placedId != null) {
        Column(modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp).testTag("order_confirmed"), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Text("Order placed 🎉", style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)
            Text("Order $placedId is on its way to ${vm.city}.", modifier = Modifier.testTag("order_id"))
        }
        return
    }

    Column(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
            .padding(16.dp)
            .testTag("checkout_screen"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
        if (product != null) {
            Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                Row(Modifier.padding(16.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
                    Text("${product.emoji} ${product.name}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                    Text(product.priceLabel(), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.testTag("checkout_total"))
                }
            }
        }

        Text("Delivery details", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
        CheckoutField("Full name", vm.name, { vm.name = it }, "field_name")
        CheckoutField("Email", vm.email, { vm.email = it }, "field_email", KeyboardType.Email)
        CheckoutField("Phone", vm.phone, { vm.phone = it }, "field_phone", KeyboardType.Phone)
        CheckoutField("Address", vm.address, { vm.address = it }, "field_address")
        CheckoutField("City", vm.city, { vm.city = it }, "field_city")
        CheckoutField("Pincode", vm.pincode, { vm.pincode = it }, "field_pincode", KeyboardType.Number)

        ScanCouponButton()

        Button(
            onClick = { vm.placeOrder(orders, productId) },
            enabled = vm.isComplete && !vm.placing,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("place_order"),
        ) {
            if (vm.placing) CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.testTag("placing_order")) else Text("Place order")
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CheckoutField(
    label: String,
    value: String,
    onChange: (String) -> Unit,
    tag: String,
    keyboard: KeyboardType = KeyboardType.Text,
) {
    OutlinedTextField(
        value = value,
        onValueChange = onChange,
        label = { Text(label) },
        singleLine = true,
        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = keyboard),
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag(tag),
    )
}

content.text:
`CheckoutViewModel` now catches the `IOException` from the order submit, so dropping the network no longer crashes the app. The unit test compiles; I did not run it, the app or the attack.

The submit logic moved into an internal `submitOrder` function that takes the submit function as a parameter. It clears any old error, catches `IOException` into a new `error` state, and always resets `placing` in a `finally`. `CheckoutScreen` shows the error in red and relabels the button "Retry". The form values are kept. The screen now passes `orders::submit`, so `OrderRepository` itself is unchanged.

The test is `CheckoutViewModelTest`. It calls `submitOrder` directly with a fake that throws `IOException`, not `placeOrder`. The project has no coroutines-test library, so `viewModelScope` can't run on the JVM. It asserts that `placing` is false, `orderId` is null and `error` is non-null. On the old code the exception would escape and fail the test.
